'''Kinoss''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was located within the [[Kinoss system/Legends|Kinoss system]], in the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Space]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. It was connected by the [[Cressus Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Bogo Rai system/Legends|Bogo Rai system]], and other [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] routes linked the planet to the [[Avidich system/Legends|Avidich system]] and to regions lying west of the core territory of the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] Ascendancy, the government of the Chiss [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TEA" />

Similarly to the planet [[Cormit/Legends|Cormit]], Kinoss served as one of the two major staging and resupply bases for the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force|Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet]]. In addition, an [[Armor/Legends|armory]] and munitions depot was located on the planet.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kinoss was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the planet in grid square E-8.<ref name="TEA" />
